Package boundary.commonDisplays

Class InternshipView

java.lang.Object
boundary.commonDisplays.InternshipView
public class InternshipView extends Object
Provides static utility methods for displaying lists of Internship objects in different formats based on the user type.

This class is not intended to be instantiated. All methods are static.

  • Method Details

    • displayStudentView

      public static void displayStudentView(List<Internship> internships)
      Displays a list of internships from the perspective of a Student. This view includes details relevant to an applicant, such as title, description, level, major, dates, company, and slot availability.

      If the list is empty, it prints a message indicating no internships are available.

      Parameters:
      internships - The list of Internship objects to display.

    • displayStaffView

      public static void displayStaffView(List<Internship> internships)
      Displays a comprehensive list of internships from the perspective of an admin or anyone who can see visibility status. This view includes all student-facing details plus administrative information like visibility and status.

      If the list is empty, it prints a message indicating no internships match the filter.

      Parameters:
      internships - The list of Internship objects to display.
